_comment: MEM-002: The SQLite memory layer must support differentiated queries so that same-game old news, same-game new events, and same-event follow-ups are distinct and independently queryable. Overlapping results that blur these categories indicate a deduplication or indexing defect.

scenario.description: The database contains three articles all referencing the same game 'Project Nebula': (a) a two-week-old news item about its delay, (b) a same-day announcement of a new DLC, and (c) a same-day follow-up article about the DLC's pricing. Queries must return each distinctly without cross-contamination.
